origin.description: Run code with a mapping attached to the search path.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the mapping is attached.

origin.details: The mapping is detached after code, even when code raises.
origin.example:
env <- list2env(list(value = 42))
found <- with_environment(env, get("value"), name = "withr-check-env")
paste(found, if ("withr-check-env" %in% search()) "attached" else "detached")

translation.description: Run code with a mapping attached to the search path.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the mapping is attached.

translation.details: The mapping is detached after code, even when code raises. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

found = with_environment({"value": 42}, lambda: lookup("value"), name="withr-check-env")
flag = "attached" if "withr-check-env" in search() else "detached"
return f"{found} {flag}"
